reason: Adds a Files tab to the conversation window with a VSCode-style workspace tree and read-only viewer for text, Markdown, code, JSON, and supported images, including refresh, copy, download, and system-app opening actions.

summaries.zh: 在对话窗口中提供文件标签页，用于浏览工作区目录并以只读方式查看文本、Markdown、代码、JSON和常见图像文件。
summaries.en: Adds a Files tab for browsing the workspace directory and viewing text, Markdown, code, JSON, and common image files in a read-only interface.

capabilities: Reads and displays workspace directory listings and file contents
Renders Markdown, text, code, JSON, and supported image files
Provides copy, download, refresh, and open-in-system-app actions
Serves workspace file data through plugin HTTP routes
